attributes.name: date_visual_treatment
attributes.definition: How dates are styled visually (container, case, spacing, colour emphasis).

values.definition: Date placed in a solid-colour badge or box with contrasting text.
Date in small uppercase text with wide letter-spacing, no box.
Date in subdued grey or low-emphasis secondary text.
Date in a small accent-coloured text, distinct from the title.
Date has no distinctive treatment or is not specified.

attributes.name: date_placement_in_item
attributes.definition: Where the date sits relative to the title and other metadata within a listing item.

values.definition: Date in its own column alongside title and link in a row.
Date inline with author or other meta items on one line, separated by a delimiter.

attributes.name: meta_separator
attributes.definition: Delimiter character used between inline metadata items.

values.definition: No separator used or not stated.

attributes.name: listing_structure
attributes.definition: How a set of news or event items is organised.

values.definition: Rows divided by rules with multiple columns.
